text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service 'nightly-batch-workers' (P2) — alert: job-queue-consumer error rate spike > 10% — link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345

oncall-jay: Ack'd. I'm the night rotation. Jumping in to check logs and consumers.

maria: FYI I just checked the alert rule — looks like the alert has an action binding to 'nightly-batch-workers' but should be bound to 'data-platform-batch' (we split services last month). Could be a rule copy-paste from last deploy.

alex: Oh no. I touched the metric alert templates yesterday when cleaning up noise. Did we push a template that rewired the PD service field?

sam: Can someone confirm customer impact? Any live traffic failing or just retries/backlog?

oncall-jay: Seeing a small backlog on the consumer (approx 2k msgs). Retry loop ongoing, latency up for batch job checkpoints. No 5xx spikes in public APIs yet. Looks contained to batch shard cluster.

jessie: Product-support: We have one enterprise customer (acme-corp) with a scheduled nightly job that might be delayed — reaching out to them preemptively.

ops-rotation: Quick note — because the page targeted the wrong PD service, the normal data-platform oncall didn't get paged. Jay is not on that schedule so handoff is awkward. We should re-route the alerts to the correct service so the right team sees it.

sam: Proposing a temporary reroute in PagerDuty to point the alert at 'data-platform-batch' and then revert after we fix the template. Anyone object?

alex: +1 do it. Also tagging incident because template change was the root cause. I'll own the rollout revert.

oncall-jay: Before reroute — I can attempt a local consumer restart on the affected shard to buy time. Running graceful restart now.

incident-bot: action: oncall-jay restarted consumer shard-7 (cmd: systemctl restart batch-consumer@7) — restart completed, consumer reconnected, backlog processing resumed.

maria: Running a quick check on alerting templates. Found this in the template that maps alert -> PD service:
```
alert_notify:
  service: "{{ env.PD_SERVICE | default('nightly-batch-workers') }}"
```
It defaulted to nightly-batch-workers in CI; should be data-platform-batch. Someone must have merged a template without env set.

sam: I'm going to apply a one-off PD reroute via the API to attach the active incident to the correct service so the proper escalation path is used. Command:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345/merge" -H "Authorization: Token token=REDACTED" -d '{"service":"data-platform-batch"}'
```
I'll follow up once PD acknowledges.

ops-rotation: tagging @product-support — keep customer notified with ETA. Also create a follow-up ticket for cleanup.

product-support: Noted. Reached out to Acme with an FYI; they confirmed they're seeing delayed job completion but not data loss. Appreciative of the heads-up.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD12345 reassigned to service 'data-platform-batch' and notified rotation.

oncall-jay: Thanks. Now that backlogs are draining and proper oncall team is engaged, what's the plan for immediate mitigation and longer-term fix?

alex: Immediate: revert the template change that caused the default to fallback to nightly-batch-workers. I'll push a rollback in infra/alerting repo and tag infra-ops for a safe deploy.

maria: Also updating the alerting CI to fail if PD_SERVICE is not set for template merges. I'll open a PR with that guard.

sam: For the short term, I propose we add a PD dedupe rule to avoid cross-service noise during template transitions. Filed PD ticket PD-TICKET-987.

jessie: Customer comms: Acme wants a note when their job is complete and an RCA. We'll keep them updated.

oncall-jay: Confirming backlog now down to ~200 msgs and processing normal. No further action required from night rotation. Passing to data-platform oncall.

ops-rotation: Data-platform oncall (on duty) acknowledged and will own follow-ups.

sre-bot: Post-incident checklist reminder: please add timeline, root cause, mitigation, and action items to #incidents-log and link to PD incident PD12345.

alex: I'll draft the RCA and assign action items: (1) revert template (owner: alex, due: today), (2) CI guard for PD_SERVICE (owner: maria, due: tomorrow), (3) PD routing test suite (owner: sam, due: next week).

product-support: Acme notified that job is completed. They want a follow-up next week for impact summary.

oncall-jay: No more symptoms from my side. marking as resolved locally. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 marked as 'resolved' at 3032104689 by data-platform oncall.

jessie: Adding a short blurb to exec-ops about the misroute and the customer outreach.

maria: I'll open the PRs now and link them here. Thanks everyone for quick responses.

alex: For the postmortem, recommend we include a small runbook entry: how to verify PD service mapping after template changes, and a pre-deploy PD routing smoke test.

ops-rotation: Agreed. Closing the thread once RCAs are attached to PD incident.

product-support: Closing loop with Acme scheduled for Monday.

end of thread
